sound_clip.description: One audio clip in a sound slot's playlist: a file plus its volume and trim window.

end.description: Trim out-point in seconds. 0.0 is the SENTINEL for 'play to the end of the file' (never null -- a nullable/union node breaks the balancing panel). Bounded at 3600 s for the same reason as start.

file.description: Path relative to data/audio/ (e.g. 'imported/building_death_a.ogg'). Empty string = no clip.

start.description: Trim in-point in seconds; 0.0 plays from the beginning. Bounded at 3600 s (one hour), a deliberate approved deviation from the 0-60 s convention, which was written for VFX timings -- music tracks run minutes.

volume.description: Clip gain as a fraction 0..1, multiplied by the bus volume and the master volume.

sound_slot.description: A sound event: zero or more clips plus how to play them. Empty clips on a global default means silence; empty clips on a per-element override means inherit the global default.

clips.description: The clips this event may play. Empty on a global default = silence; empty on a per-element override = inherit the global default.

loop.description: Repeat the chosen clip until stopped (music and ambience) rather than playing it once.

pick.description: How the next clip is chosen when the slot holds more than one: 'random' picks any, 'sequential' cycles in order.

description: Map balancing domain (D-10), REPLAN nested tree (Phase 9A): tile unlocking, pathfinding weights, tile conditions. Values are the prototype's live tuning, verbatim. Bounds policy: fractions/chances 0-1, costs/counts 0-10000, rounds 0-1000. (The map FILE format is schemas/map_file.schema.json - this is the balancing domain.)

Pathfinding.description: Dijkstra edge weights by tile content, plus damage-based weight reduction.

buildings_overwrite_tileweights.description: Master switch: when true, a live building's content weight OVERWRITES its tile's terrain condition weight instead of adding to it (stops the water-parking exploit). OR'd with content_weight_overwrites/path_weight_overwritable per-key overrides.

content_weight_overwrites.description: Per-building-type override: when true, that building's content weight OVERWRITES its tile's terrain condition weight instead of adding to it, independent of the master switch. Non-building content keys (buildable_tile/combat_tile/spawning_tile/impassable) have no entry here - they never occupy a tile.

aoe_defence_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when an AOE defence building occupies the tile.

base_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when the base building occupies the tile.

blocker_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when a blocker structure occupies the tile.

boost_damage_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when a damage boost building occupies the tile.

boost_hp_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when an HP boost building occupies the tile.

boost_speed_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when a speed boost building occupies the tile.

defence_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when a basic defence building occupies the tile.

economic_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when an economy building occupies the tile.

meditator_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when a meditator building occupies the tile.

painter_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when a painter building occupies the tile.

storm_priest_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when a storm priest building occupies the tile.

sun_scorcher_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when a sun scorcher building occupies the tile.

wall_builder_building.description: Overwrite terrain weight when a wall builder structure occupies the tile.

content_weights.description: Path weight contributed by what stands on a tile (higher = avoided; impassable is effectively a wall). Building keys ADD to a tile's terrain condition weight by default, or OVERWRITE it when buildings_overwrite_tileweights / content_weight_overwrites / path_weight_overwritable resolves true for that tile (see Pathfinding docs).

aoe_defence_building.description: Weight of a tile holding an AOE defence building.

base_building.description: Weight of the base tile (0 keeps the hole maximally attractive).

blocker_building.description: Weight of a tile holding a blocker structure.

boost_damage_building.description: Weight of a tile holding a damage boost building.

boost_hp_building.description: Weight of a tile holding an HP boost building.

boost_speed_building.description: Weight of a tile holding a speed boost building.

buildable_tile.description: Weight of an empty buildable tile.

combat_tile.description: Weight of an unlocked combat-zone tile.

defence_building.description: Weight of a tile holding a basic defence building.

economic_building.description: Weight of a tile holding an economy building.

impassable.description: Weight of an impassable tile (effectively infinite).

meditator_building.description: Weight of a tile holding a meditator building.

painter_building.description: Weight of a tile holding a painter building.

storm_priest_building.description: Weight of a tile holding a storm priest building.

sun_scorcher_building.description: Weight of a tile holding a sun scorcher building.

wall_builder_building.description: Weight of a tile holding a wall builder structure.

damage_reduction.description: Tiles where enemies recently died get cheaper, funneling later waves.

min_round.description: First round the damage-based reduction applies.

reduction.description: Fraction removed from a qualifying tile's weight.

top_n.description: How many highest-damage tiles qualify for the reduction.

buy_plot.description: Played when a tile/plot is bought.

tile_placement.description: Played when something is placed onto a tile.

SpawnDeco.description: Decorative tree props scattered over spawn-zone tiles.

tree_chance.description: Chance [0,1] that a SPAWNING tile rolls a random decorative tree at map construction; the roll is cached per-tile and the tree is hidden (not re-rolled) once the tile converts to COMBAT.

TileConditions.description: Random per-tile terrain conditions: spawn odds, path weights, stat modifiers.

min_speed_fraction.description: Floor under a terrain-penalised enemy's move speed, as a fraction of its OWN base speed: conditioned speed is max(speed * this, speed - enemy_speed_penalty). Stops a unit slower than the flat penalty (the boss, at 0.3-0.45 t/s vs 0.4) from being welded to zero. Raise it above ~0.55 and it starts overriding the penalty for the normal enemy types too.

modifiers.description: Stat modifiers applied to whatever occupies a conditioned tile.

eco_yield_bonus.description: Fraction added to economy yield in a forest.

def_range_bonus.description: Extra attack range in tiles for defenders on a mountain.

path_weight_overwritable.description: Per-condition override: when true, a live overwriting building on a tile of this condition drops the terrain condition weight entirely (overwrite) rather than adding to it, independent of the master switch and the per-building overrides.

forest.description: Overwritable when the tile's condition is forest.

mountain.description: Overwritable when the tile's condition is mountain.

pond.description: Overwritable when the tile's condition is pond.

path_weights.description: Extra path weight per condition (higher = enemies avoid it).

forest.description: Extra weight of a forest tile.

mountain.description: Extra weight of a mountain tile.

pond.description: Extra weight of a pond tile.

spawn_chances.description: Probability each freshly revealed tile rolls a condition (should sum to 1).

TileUnlocking.description: Spending love to unlock map tiles (2x2 chunks, spawn zone recedes).

adjacent_unlock_only.description: If true only chunks adjacent to already-unlocked land can be bought.

base_unlock_cost.description: Love cost of the nearest unlockable chunk.

spawn_recede_enabled.description: Master switch for the OLD implicit spawn-recede rule (spawning tiles turning buildable as the player unlocks land). If false the spawn band never recedes on unlock, whatever the painted spawn-reserve state is.

unlock_cost_distance_mod.description: Extra love cost per tile of distance from the base.
